run_island_discovery: run island discovery to partition constraint trees into connected islands for parallel solver execution
build_tree_edges_matrix: build a tree-tree adjacency matrix from constraint types including equality, friction, limit, and contact constraints
test_flood_fill_islands: test the DFS flood fill kernel that assigns tree nodes to constraint islands using the adjacency matrix
review_tree_edges_kernel: review the _tree_edges kernel that classifies constraint types and maps them to tree-tree edges
summarize_island_module: summarize the island module that discovers connected constraint islands for parallelized physics simulation
